passage.label: Indeed criminals used laugh believers; passed exchange derisive glances; returned people jesting; saw them say indeed truly lost; not sent guardians over them; Today believers laughing disbelievers; adorned couches observing; disbelievers rewarded Day what used do

arabicExcerpts.text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجۡرَمُواْ كَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَضۡحَكُونَ
وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُواْ فَكِهِينَ
وَإِذَا رَأَوۡهُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡكُفَّارِ يَضۡحَكُونَ
هَلۡ ثُوِّبَ ٱلۡكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ

mainSubject.label: Criminals who used to laugh at believers, exchange derisive glances when passing, return jesting to their people and declare the believers truly lost despite never being appointed guardians over them; today the reversal occurs as believers laugh at the disbelievers from adorned couches while observing, with the disbelievers recompensed for what they used to do

subordinateSubjects.label: Criminals who used to laugh at the believers
Exchanging derisive glances when passing them
Returning to their own people jesting
Declaring the believers truly lost when seeing them
Yet they had never been sent as guardians over them
Today the believers laugh at the disbelievers
The disbelievers recompensed for what they used to do

notes: Wave 12 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the standing-before-the-Lord statement (6) before the Sijjeen record block opens (7); P2 ends with the this-is-what-you-denied declaration (17) before the Illiyyun record block begins (18); P3 runs through the inscribed register, couch-radiance, sealed wine and Tasneem spring (18-28); P4 covers the criminal-mockery catalogue and its eschatological reversal (29-36).
